text:
Arjun: Heads up — planning to onboard chorus-3b-v2 to model catalog TOMORROW 2026-03-18 10:00 PDT. Need deploy owner, smoke runner, rollback owner. Rolling to hosted + dedicated. TL;DR: pin = chorus-3b:v2, canary 5% for 30m.
Maya: I can own deploy (start + config). Is there a deploy checklist?
Arjun: Thanks! Checklist:
- update model entry
- add performance profile
- set canary rules
- schedule pin
Quick commands below.
Arjun: ```bash
# add model to catalog
redwood catalog add --name chorus-3b --version v2 --notes 'v2: better contextualization'
# pin to route
redwood catalog pin set --route text-generation --model chorus-3b:v2
# create canary
redwood canary create --route text-generation --pct 5 --duration 30m --on-success escalate 100%:2h
```
Leo: I'll run smoke tests and monitor traces. Which metrics should I watch?
Arjun: latency p50/p95, error rate, token cost delta, and top error samples. Watch model:chorus-3b:v2 route in Console. Alerts are set to notify #eng-oncall and deploy channel.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window: 2026-03-18 10:00 PDT. Canary 5% -> 100% over 2h if no regressions. Contact @Leo for smoke, @Maya for deploy, @Sophie for rollback.
Sophie: I can be rollback owner. Rollback command if needed:
```bash
# revert pin to previous stable
redwood catalog pin set --route text-generation --model chorus-3b:stable
# optionally abort canary
redwood canary abort --id <canary-id>
```
Maya: Can we delay quantized variant launch? want to verify float perf first.
Arjun: Yes — no quant in canary. We'll add quant variant after full rollout and perf review.
Leo: Smoke steps (short):
1) curl a sample prompt and check output sanity
2) run baseline diff (small dif tool)
3) run light load: 1k tokens through a short script
Example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"chorus-3b:v2","prompt":"Summarize: ...","max_tokens":128}'
# python quick load
python tools/load_test.py --model chorus-3b:v2 --requests 200 --concurrency 5
```
Maya: :thumbsup: I'll kick off preflight at 09:45 PDT to warm pools and validate configs. If anything weird, ping #eng-oncall and DM me.
Arjun: Thanks — owners noted: deploy=Maya, smoke=Leo, rollback=Sophie. Backup smoke after 11:30 = Sophie. I'll post final checklist in morning and update the catalog entry now.
Sophie: leaving a note to add eval set id: ev-chorus-3b-v2 to the model metadata.
Arjun: Good call. Captured.
